Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Automatically price new and existing retainer listings.
Description: Automatically price eligible inventory and reprice existing listings one gil below matching competition using Universalis market prices and recent sale history.
Changelog: Auto update now advances retainer greeting dialogue more reliably, Auto vendor uses the game's verified vendor sale action, and Sniper shows its deal threshold as a percentage. Also includes spiritbound-item filtering, /retainer, stacks above 99, repricing review bands, and Sniper value and sorting controls.
